builds.name: Headshot: crit stats and a trap bonus
builds.summary: Investigate high one trap-enabled Headshot delivery output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one trap-enabled Headshot delivery output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Headshot bonus uses a level-dependent AD coefficient plus critical chance times the excess critical-damage factor times total AD. A rank-5 trap adds 215 + 0.3 bonus AD. Infinity Edge and 100% item crit can therefore matter through both ordinary delivery and the bespoke Headshot term. These components must be distinguished; a trap does not grant two separate passive Headshots on the same attack.
